needsBespoke.why: Fury is a resource that both generates from all sources (attacks, abilities) and decays out-of-combat, and Furious Bite's damage type/amount depends non-linearly on current Fury (only fully converts to 1.2x true damage exactly at 100 Fury, otherwise scales as plain physical damage at RekSaiE.BaseDamageCalculation with no partial bonus described). The simulator needs bespoke logic to track a Fury meter across the 15s rotation (gains of 25 per ability/attack, decay after 8s out of combat) to decide whether each Furious Bite cast lands as physical or true/empowered damage — this is more than a simple resource-budget primitive since it also gates a conditional-damage branch, and the two interact (attack resets from Q change how fast Fury accumulates).

unsettled.question: Does Furious Bite's damage scale continuously with current Fury (partial bonus below 100) or is it strictly binary (normal damage below 100 Fury, full 1.2x true damage only at exactly 100 Fury)?
options: Binary: only max Fury (100) grants the 1.2x true damage conversion, otherwise plain physical damage per RekSaiE.BaseDamageCalculation
Continuous: some partial scaling with Fury percentage is applied even below 100
